text: $XRPUSD ( $XRPI  ETF) via  $XXRP  2x Long (Weekly Bullish Flag)  Strength in crypto resurfaced as evident on Friday's close in  $WGMI  group (+7.14%) and  $BtcUSD  +5.9% move. Among the 4 main crypto coins which compressed during the 2 prints over the weekend, only spot $XRPUSD offers a setup below 4 x ATR% from 50-MA, and remains beneath a pivotal breakout level similar to $BTCUSD.

Stalk  $SMCI  via  $SMCX  (Follow Through of Weekly Bullish Wedge)  Price peaked in  $SMCI  in March 2024 and has retrace and flatten into a multi month bullish wedge with price reclaiming all major MA above the wedge line for the first time this month. Recent PEG has attempt to fill June 10th gap down resistance, but price couldn't follow through and has side way for the last 5 weeks, with attempt to breach $40 in 5 occasions without RVOL.   Latest recent gap up from last Thursday revisited $40 and rejected on Friday but gap up support remains untested. Price print has higher low. Just another tightened price action is sufficient for me to Focus this on Tuesday.

Focus  $SNOW  (PEG Delayed Reaction)  Price structure still remains valid considering it reclaimed 10 and 20-MA on Thursday, while remaining sideway on friday's red print across all  $BUG  and  $CIBR  name. ATR% from 50-MA extension is only 1.5.

Stalk  $ZETA  (Box Range)  Box range remains with attempt to break below on Friday, before late session reclaim. Range has expanded, will need another 2 tightened session before upgrading it back to Focus again.

Focus  $XLK  via  $TECL  3x long  The only trade <70% LoD i am looking today that has gap filled yet remains below 3 x ATR% from 50-MA while trading above all MA.   Roll your risk exposure into this market slowly, don't ever have the feeling of FOMO because it can be catastrophic if market turn its tune in just an instance.
